question: 按证券类型统计 2015 年成交笔数，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT ds.Issue AS issue, COUNT(ft.TradeID) AS trade_count FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_security ds ON ft.SK_SecurityID = ds.SK_SecurityID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2015 GROUP BY ds.Issue ORDER BY trade_count DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: Issue 区分股票(COMMON/PREF)等证券子类
对证券交易事件的计数
